summary: AUNA S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, reporting preliminary key performance indicators for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing discloses select operating metrics across its healthcare services segments in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia, including emergency treatments, surgeries, hospital days, capacity utilization, and chemotherapy sessions. No terms such as price per share, premium, or deal structure are mentioned. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory timetable. This is a routine quarterly operational update and does not constitute a special situation.
